entries.title: Sources lists related work the article leaves out
entries.body: Sources has a new view beside Bibliography, called Not cited, on articles you added: press Search OpenAlex for related work and it lists related papers, books and reports that the article's bibliography leaves out, with links and abstract excerpts where available. It uses no AI. Because the search sends OpenAlex, an outside service, the article's title and the opening of its text, it runs only when you press the button.
